inside segment 4, centred, set on two lines: 'Access' on the first line and 'controlled' on the second line, no hyphen

mandatory: Exactly six segments of identical width and height in one straight horizontal row, in the order Visible, Attributable, Least privileged, Access controlled, Screened, Measured
The segments are tall and fill the segment row: each segment is at least 40% of the frame height tall, so the frame has no large empty area
All six segments are light gray (neutral); none is green
Exactly six module tags, one centred under each segment, reading M1, M1, M1, M2, M3, M4 · optional from left to right
The last tag reads exactly 'M4 · optional' with a middle dot
Exactly two red markers reading 'Gap found in M0', one above Visible and one above Attributable; no marker above the other four
'Least privileged' is set on two lines: 'Least' then 'privileged'; 'Access controlled' is set on two lines: 'Access' then 'controlled'; neither has a hyphen character anywhere
All six segment labels use the same semibold weight and size in near-black ink; each is fully inside its segment and no single word is broken
The title is bold, large, top-left and on one line
All text is large enough to read when the image is 1000px wide
Simple, regular geometry so the same layout can be reused with segments recoloured
All six segments have the identical medium gray outline (#8A9099); a marker's pointer stops just above its segment and never touches or recolors the segment's border
prohibitions: NO third-party logos and NO Google logo
NO 'Vertex AI', 'Agent Engine', 'reasoning engine' or 'reasoningEngines' anywhere
NO project IDs, NO email addresses, NO 'projects/' paths, NO '@' characters
NO people, faces, hands or characters
NO check marks, ticks, crosses, stars or progress percentages
NO green anywhere in the image
NO arrows, NO connecting lines between segments
NO text that is not listed in text_exact
NO property word other than the six listed
NO hyphen character in any segment label (never 'Least-' or 'Access-')
NO red, amber or coloured outline on any segment
